sections.label: Early game
sections.desc: Souls 0-9,600 (levels 1-16). 4.8k spikes: weapon 4.8k at Cultist Sacrifice.

items.name: Restorative Shot
items.caption: Temporary, sold when you buy Diviner's Kevlar later.
items.why: on the path to the build's first 4.8k (weapon): Cultist Sacrifice completes 4.8k weapon in 6400 souls (~6.4 min), 5 purchases

items.name: Monster Rounds
items.caption: Builds toward the 4.8k weapon tier, which Cultist Sacrifice completes 5,600 souls on.
items.why: on the path to the build's first 4.8k (weapon): Cultist Sacrifice completes 4.8k weapon in 5600 souls (~5.6 min), 4 purchases

items.name: Battle Vest
items.why: vitality investment only; its 4.8k tier completes at Majestic Leap, 12000 souls (~12.0 min) later and vitality is not the first spike colour: timing review (delay, or is a lane/stat reason missing?)

items.name: Mystic Burst
items.caption: Enchanter's Satchel (172), Flying Cloak (151) clear its 80-damage trigger; Barrage stays under it.

items.name: Rapid Rounds
items.caption: Builds toward the 4.8k weapon tier, which Cultist Sacrifice completes 2,400 souls on.
items.why: imminent: Cultist Sacrifice completes 4.8k weapon in 2400 souls (~2.4 min), 1 purchases

items.name: Cultist Sacrifice
items.caption: Completes the 4.8k weapon tier (2,400 to 4,800 invested): bonus 15 to 46% weapon damage. Upgrade of Monster Rounds (already owned): costs 2,400 souls more, not 3,200.
items.legacy_note: Use it on the biggest camp monster you can find.

items.name: Swift Striker
items.why: weapon investment only and the build never reaches the 6.4k weapon tier through the core: timing review

items.name: Compress Cooldown
items.caption: Imbued on Flying Cloak: takes 18% off its 26s base cooldown.

sections.label: Midgame
sections.desc: Souls 9,600-30,400 (levels 16-30). Abilities gained (both point models agree): Barrage T3, Affliction T3. Your biggest single spirit hit (Enchanter's Satchel, damage) grows from 190 to 263. 4.8k spikes: spirit 4.8k at Tankbuster, vitality 4.8k at Majestic Leap.

items.name: Tankbuster
items.caption: Completes the 4.8k spirit tier (2,400 to 4,800 invested): bonus 15 to 38 spirit power. Upgrade of Mystic Burst (already owned): costs 2,400 souls more, not 3,200.

items.name: Majestic Leap
items.caption: Completes the 4.8k vitality tier (1,600 to 4,800 invested): bonus 12 to 38 vitality bonus.

items.name: Mystic Expansion
items.caption: Imbued on Barrage: widens its range.
items.why: imminent: Superior Cooldown completes 6.4k spirit in 1600 souls (~1.6 min), 1 purchases

items.name: Superior Cooldown
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes spirit from 5,600 to 7,200 invested: bonus 38 to 45 spirit power. | With 4 abilities trained their base cooldowns total 189s; 20% off is 37.8s per full rotation.

items.name: Dispel Magic
items.caption: Purges non-ultimate debuffs (silence, slow, disarm) and heals 250, but cannot be used while stunned or asleep, so it answers a hex or silence and not a stun already on you. Takes vitality from 4,800 to 8,000 invested, crossing the 6.4k, 8k tiers: bonus 38 to 46 vitality bonus.

items.name: Duration Extender
items.caption: Imbued on Affliction: its duration-scaled parts (debuff duration 13s) get +22%. Takes spirit from 7,200 to 8,800 invested: bonus 45 to 52 spirit power.

items.name: Spirit Burn
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes spirit from 8,800 to 15,200 invested: bonus 52 to 59 spirit power.

items.name: Superior Duration
items.caption: +28% to every duration-scaled effect you have: Affliction debuff duration (13s), Barrage amp duration (15s), Flying Cloak weapon damage bonus duration (6s). Takes spirit from 15,200 to 16,800 invested: bonus 59 to 66 spirit power. Upgrade of Duration Extender (already owned): costs 1,600 souls more, not 3,200.

sections.label: Late game
sections.desc: Souls 30,400-45,600 (levels 30-35). Abilities gained (both point models agree): Flying Cloak T3.

items.name: Greater Expansion
items.caption: +30% range and radius on everything that scales with them: Affliction radius (13m), Enchanter's Satchel radius (12m), Barrage radius (7.5m). Upgrade of Mystic Expansion (already owned): costs 2,400 souls more, not 3,200.

items.name: Ethereal Shift
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes spirit from 19,200 to 25,600 invested: bonus 66 to 75 spirit power.

items.name: Diviner's Kevlar
items.caption: Casting Affliction gives a 1,000 barrier and +40 spirit for 20s, available once per ultimate cooldown (135s at your current ultimate tier), so it is a once-per-fight burst of defence. Takes vitality from 8,000 to 14,400 invested: bonus 46 to 50 vitality bonus.

sections.label: Situational counters
sections.legacy_desc: Dying after Majestic Leap? Buy what is killing you, cheapest first. Not dying? Skip. Sell Battle Vest.
sections.desc: Dying after Majestic Leap? Buy what is killing you, cheapest first. Not dying? Skip. Sell Battle Vest.

items.name: Metal Skin
items.caption: Immune to bullets only, for 5s on a 24s cooldown, at 1.5m/s slower: buy it against one gun carry, not against ability damage.
items.legacy_note: Their gun carry is melting you.

items.name: Plated Armor
items.caption: Passive: 30% chance to deflect a bullet and 50% to block its on-hit effects; it helps against several gun heroes at once where a timed bullet immunity covers only one.
items.legacy_note: Most of their damage is gun.

items.name: Spirit Shielding
items.why: no hero-, build- or timing-specific reason established from the data layers implemented
items.legacy_note: Their spirit burst catches you mid combo.

items.name: Unstoppable
items.caption: A stun cancels your Barrage (channelled) and Enchanter's Satchel (channelled). Activate this before the stun lands (it cannot be used while stunned): 5.5s immune to stun, silence, sleep, root and disarm, 60s cooldown.
items.legacy_note: Stuns keep cancelling Barrage and the ult.

items.name: Counterspell
items.caption: Your next parry blocks an enemy ability's damage and effects (0.8s window, 23s cooldown), so it only answers an ability you can see coming.
items.legacy_note: A big ability you can see coming, like Bebop's hook or Apollo's ult.

items.name: Escalating Exposure
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes spirit from 25,600 to 28,800 invested: bonus 75 to 100 spirit power.

items.name: Divine Barrier
items.caption: Cast on yourself or an ally: removes non-stun debuffs and gives a 600 barrier for 6s, 45s cooldown (halved when cast on an ally), so it covers debuffs and burst damage but not a stun. Takes vitality from 14,400 to 17,600 invested: bonus 50 to 54 vitality bonus.

items.name: Arctic Blast
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes spirit from 25,600 to 32,000 invested: bonus 75 to 100 spirit power.

items.name: Mystic Reverb
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes spirit from 25,600 to 28,800 invested: bonus 75 to 100 spirit power.
items.legacy_note: On Enchanter's Satchel. Sell Superior Duration for this.

items.name: Refresher
items.caption: Resets every ability and charge: up to 179s of base cooldown across your kit, 135s of it the ultimate; the item has its own cooldown of 300s. Takes spirit from 25,600 to 28,800 invested: bonus 75 to 100 spirit power. Replaces Tankbuster: sell it when you buy this (all 12 slots are full).

items.name: Transcendent Cooldown
items.caption: Same-slot upgrade of Superior Cooldown for 3,200 more souls: item cooldown reduction 0 to 25; cooldown reduction 20 to 25..
